Microsoft Bing is testing a new flavor of AI-generated answers that are labeled "AI-Generated answer" and seem to be different from the Bing AI Overviews and Copilot Search boxes.
Microsoft labels these as "This summary was generated using Al based on multiple structures based on your world seed online sources. To view the original source information, use the "Learn more" links."
This was spotted first by Venkat who wrote on SEW, "Bing Search is showing a standalone “AI Generated answer” card in mobile results, separate from the regular search listings."
